notes: Improves license entry, license management, and update-screen rendering with smaller redraws, cached effects, and elapsed-time animation. Preserves terminal glitch transitions and typing at a 30 Hz update cadence. Restores popup, DESIGN/PLAY, and game animations in Windows FL Studio by removing its automatic reduced-animation override. Includes universal macOS AU/VST3, Windows x64 VST3, and Linux x86_64 VST3 packages.
